thread.title: Florence receives audit extension amid FBI probe into revenue diversion
thread.title_full: Florence receives audit extension amid FBI probe into revenue diversion

author: M. S. Herrick
title: Florence receives audit extension amid FBI probe into revenue diversion
text:
The City of Florence has been granted an extension for its annual audit submission by the Kentucky Department of Local Government. The request for additional time came after city officials discovered revenue diversion activities affecting a specific revenue stream.
These activities were identified following the implementation of new financial oversight procedures directed by Mayor Dr. Julie Aubuchon. The changes were part of a broader reorganization of the Finance Department in 2025, which occurred after the departure of the city’s chief financial officer.
According to city officials, the revenue diversion began before Mayor Aubuchon assumed office in 2023 and was not limited to a single incident. After identifying the issue, city leaders contacted the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) and provided all relevant information. The FBI is now conducting an independent criminal investigation, with full cooperation from the City of Florence. In response, city management has introduced new processes and controls aimed at preventing future occurrences.
“Because this is an active federal criminal investigation, there are limits on what we can share,” said Mayor Aubuchon. “But it is important our residents know that it was the City that uncovered the revenue diversion and it was the City that requested the federal investigation. Once the results of the FBI investigation are released, we will provide additional verified information in the spirit of transparency and accountability.
“And I promise you,” the Mayor continued, “that we will aggressively hold anyone involved with this revenue diversion accountable to the fullest extent of the law, including demanding restitution.”
City officials stated they will not be making further public comments on this matter to avoid compromising ongoing federal investigations.
